Deal with [TargetName] and Support Forces
records.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> and their crew were identified executing a raid on <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. If their MO holds true, <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again. 

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force <EM4>[TargetName|Last]</EM4> to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

records.description:

Get the blackbox from the wreck at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and take it to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

records.description:
An emergency contract just came in about a fight near [Location|Address]. Apparently a group of ships were ambushed by outlaws led by [TargetName], who's been wanted on multiple planets for murder and ship theft. Foxwell's looking for top tier combat pilots to go and protect the clients against them.

This one's been flagged as a red level contract so it's really dangerous. If you have people you could bring, you probably should. If you do, you should also let them know about Foxwell's hiring policies. 

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
records.description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Away From Prying Eyes
records.description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden. 

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out. 

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

records.title: Need Resource for Research
records.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

records.description:

Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Lrg. Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
records.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Stanton System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

These ores can be mined on a planet, or moon orbiting the planet, that we require the ore to be delivered to. 

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: Oust Claimjumpers
records.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary 
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*: 
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted. 




*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: Little Heavy Lifting at Outpost Storage Shed
records.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>Outpost Storage Shed</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

When you’re done, take the gear to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

Lima Endicott

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
As a member of Alliance Aid, Shubin Interstellar is dedicated to assisting in the production of as many high quality ventilation filters as possible. These filters are key to stopping the spread of Molina Mold and keeping more people from being stricken with the People’s Ailment. 

We’ve just received word from our facility at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap. 
 
If you’re available, simply acquire it as you see best and bring it to our facility, and we’ll compensate you well.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: Major Malfunction
records.description:
I won’t go into the whole long boring story of why, but there are a few bits of [Location|Address] that we need destroyed. The important part is that I want to pay you a hefty chunk of credits to do it. I almost feel like you should be paying us for this because of how fun it’s going to be.

Don’t even care how you get it done. Grenades, rocket launcher, day old Torpedo Burrito, it’s all the same to us.

-Bit Zeros

records.title: Investigate Wreckage Claim
records.description: [Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverDescription]

records.title: Special Recovery Operation
records.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Out of Detatrine – Medium Resupply
records.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock.

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

records.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
records.description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>a Salvage Yard on Daymar</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>

And bring it all to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> should make loading and unloading nice and easy. 

-Twitch

records.title: [TargetName] Vanished
records.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to [Location|Address] and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

records.title: Headhunter attack on [Location]
records.description:
A distress call just came in from [Location|Address] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
records.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me? 

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.    

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination1|Address]</EM4>

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment. 

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   

[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

records.title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
records.description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Anybody Seen [TargetName]?
records.description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name [TargetName], to do a hand-off over at [Location|Address], but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

records.title: Return Goods
records.description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to Last Landings was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

records.title: Confidential Material Stolen
records.description:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to [Location|Address] where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.
  
Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to [Dropoff1|Address].

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend [TargetName] from [Location|Address]. 

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

records.title: Finish the job
records.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

records.title: Little Heavy Lifting at [Destination]
records.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

records.title: Unwanted Guests
records.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out. 

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

records.title: Critical Intelligence Lost
records.description:
One of our most dedicated people, [TargetName] has gone missing and I'm beside myself thinking what might have happened to them. They had been working undercover to gather intelligence on some local outlaws and managed to track down where some critical data was being stored. 

We need you to go, discern what happened to them, and if the worst has happened, continue their mission to destroy the sensitive data before it can be used against us.

From their last check in with their handler, we believe they were headed to [Location|Address]. I suggest you start your search at the small outposts near there.

Please hurry,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Multiple Pick-Up Delivery
records.description:
Hi,

All the hard work the volunteers at Citizens for Prosperity have been doing is starting to pay off. Not only have we established outposts to house and protect people looking for a peaceful life, but our goal of making each outpost prosperous in their own right is coming to fruition.

There’s a handful of outposts that have produced some valuable commodities that are ready for pick up and delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you could swing by the outposts to grab the goods?

Here’s where everything needs to be picked up from: 

Pick up package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.
Pick up package <EM4>#[Item4|SerialNumber]</EM4> at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

As always, thanks for your help making this system a little brighter.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Track Down [TargetName]
records.description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at [Location|Address]. Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to [TargetName].

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if [TargetName|Last] is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows

records.title: Red Wind Dangerous Cargo Recovery
records.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION

records.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
records.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of <EM4>[HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel</EM4> at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>Storehouse</EM4>. records.description:
My son Nico was sadly among the victims of the tragic accident at Covelex's Gundo station and they still haven't returned all of his personal possessions to me. I understand that they have to do things according to regulations, but it seems unconscionable that they wouldn't make some allowances for the grieving family members. To that end, I'm seeking someone who will be able to go to the station for me. To be clear, Gundo is currently considered off limits, meaning that this would not be above board, but I feel my situation warrants special consideration. My sister says that the rate I am offering is the correct amount for retrieving the crate with Nico's belongings (#964) and bringing them to [Destination], so hopefully I can find a competent individual to settle this matter quickly.

Sincerely,
Gloria Theolone

records.title: get the goods
records.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that a derelict outpost received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two. 

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. 

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TargetName|First]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [Destination|Address]. records.title: Seeking Experienced Combat Pilots
records.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try. 

A civilian ship has requested combat support near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.

Lima Endicott

records.description:

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all.

records.title: Fuel to the Fire
records.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

records.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [Ship]
records.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum</EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

records.title: Reprisal Attack
records.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

records.description:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack. 

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [AmbushTarget] is aggressive and battle hardened.        

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

----------------------------

records.title: Preemptive Strike
records.description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that [TargetName] is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive. 

[TargetName|Last] was just spotted with others around [Location|Address]. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.   

Stows out.

records.title: Hunt Some Heads
records.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows

records.title: Strategic Salvage Reserve – Small Resupply
records.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you could resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials.</EM4> It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets. 

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Ripe for the Taking
records.description:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

records.title: Track Down Spy
records.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on the head of [TargetName]. As a member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] hacked into XenoThreat systems to steal information on our operations and personnel. The harm done can only be rectified by ensuring [TargetName|Last] can never do something like this again. That’s why XenoThreat will pay anyone who can track down and assassinate [TargetName|Last].     

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified [TargetName|Last] traveling with other ships near [Location|Address]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

records.title: Demolition Mission
records.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Storehouse and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters. 

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

records.title: A Well Deserved Break
records.description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TargetName], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at [Location|Address].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

records.title: Exterminate Eavesdroppers
records.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at [location|address] and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone. 

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done. 

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you. 
 
Stows out.

records.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and bringing it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Ella Tieno

records.title: Should'a left it to a professional
records.description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

records.title: Silent Strike
records.description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell,  Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.

records.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
records.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

records.title: Ripe for Retribution
records.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.  

Stows out.

records.title: Crash some ships
records.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

records.title: Retrieve Supplies
records.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at Canard View. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

records.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Rustville. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

records.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
records.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TargetName] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TargetName|Last] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [Location|Address] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

records.title: Recover Cargo
records.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: All Things Come To An End
records.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

records.title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks
records.description:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their Fuel Tanks. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering  <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

records.title: Eradicate Eavesdroppers
records.description:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at [location|address]. Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun. 

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone. 

Stows out.

records.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
records.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Illegal Blockade – Medical Supplies Needed
records.description:
The illegal quantum blockade of [Location] has interrupted normal trade routes and essentials are in short supply. 

Crusader Security is looking for traders and haulers to provide much needed medical supplies to the station. 

Prices offered by the station administration will be adjusted to reflect the situation with the Nine Tails, and in addition, Crusader will provide a hazard bonus upon successful transfer of the medical supplies because of the increased risk. 

Thank you in advance for your support during these difficult times.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

records.title: Confiscate Contraband
records.description:
Crusader Security has learned that an illegal production facility at [Location|Address] is currently being used to manufacture contraband. 

We are seeking a contractor to secure the site, confiscate any contraband, and deliver it to us at Seraphim Station. The administrative commodity terminal will allow you to submit the contraband into our evidence hold and collect your payment.

Now, this is an automated facility so it’s not clear how long they’ll be manufacturing for, or even how many people may be on site. To be safe, I would go in expecting to meet heavy resistance.

Your total compensation will be based on how packages are safely delivered into evidence.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Vanzant
ID# 712L921P

records.title: RSI Disc. Month: Urgent Refuel Request ([Ship])
records.description:
Hey again,

Found a beacon from one of those new <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> ships out in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs refueling. Just got off comms with them and they said they ran into some trouble with some local outlaws and had to make a sharp exit so weren't able to fill up on <EM4><EM4>[QTFuel] SCU of Quantum Fuel</EM4><EM4> before heading out.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hoping we can get out to those nice folks before anything bad happens to them, been hearing a lot of nasty rumors about those parts recently. Watch your back and make sure you get home safely. 

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""

records.title: Track Down Traitor
records.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. A known member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last] for these crimes against Humanity.  

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was recently spotted with an escort at [Location|Address]. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

records.title: Orison Relief: Neutralize Nine Tails Reprisal
records.description:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.

You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

records.description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available?

records.title: A Chance to Impress
records.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

records.title: Delicate Dealings

If you can find a way to navigate through the mines or possibly a way to trigger them remotely, it should be relatively easy to grab the goods and make your way out of there. Drop them off at [Destination|Address] and you’ll get more than your fair cut of the credits for taking on the risk.

-Bit Zeros

records.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
records.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

records.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
records.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Two bank guards were reported missing last week. A few hours ago, their bodies turned up in a trash heap in Magnus with their biometrics stolen. Thankfully, a nearby dumpling cart had a security camera that captured the corpses being dropped. Facial recognition was able to ID one Kass Dent, romantic partner to Maltrox Arlington and parent of Les Arlington. Using the vid to construct a timeline, we have provided the coordinates of where Kass is currently believed to be hiding. 

Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.  

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

records.title: Alliance Aid: Large Supply of Research Resource
records.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the <EM4>'Forager's Guide'</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

records.title: Execute Eavesdroppers
records.description:
Headhunters recently discovered some orbital sentries focused on our operations and we don’t like it one bit. I’m looking to pay someone to go to [location|address] and make it abundantly clear they should stay the hell out of our business. Doubt they’ll be receptive to a discussion about it, so I’d be prepared to evict them with extreme force. 

Based on our scans, this won’t be a walk in the park. Wouldn’t be a bad idea to come prepared with plenty of ammo. Payment will be sent promptly once the job is done. 

Stows out.

records.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
records.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

records.title: Surprise Party
records.description:
Some numskull flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.    

There’s an emission cloud near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job.

records.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
records.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Orison and take you to visit Kel-To, a weapons store here in Orison.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

records.title: Green light on Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]
records.description:

If that's you, head over to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and take it back.

Stows out.

records.description:
We’ve got our eye on a [ship] near [location] that’s ripe for salvaging. We’re too busy to snag it ourselves, so why not spread the wealth, right?

If you send us some credits, we’ll send you the ship’s exact coordinates. Don’t take too long to think it over, though. You’ve probably got about [timer] minutes until security gets there to check out the wreck. Could be more, could be less.

You could either tow it somewhere else first, or you could try to scrap what you can onsite before security shows. Don’t care which as long as you get it taken care of. And once you've salvaged everything you want, just go ahead and abandon this contract to clear your map. Helps keep everything nice and tidy.

records.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

records.description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

records.description:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at [location|address] where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.      

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it. 

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us. 

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.     

- Smokey

Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Lima Endicott

- Stows

records.title: Tactical Strike Group Needed
records.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will <EM4>need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station</EM4> and ultimately <EM4>get boots on the ground to save their pilot</EM4>.

<EM4>Recruiting additional ships</EM4> to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will <EM4>need a variety of ship types</EM4> to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

records.title: Elite Op
records.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.  

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and its escorts to pass by. 

With a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser

records.title: A Chance to Impress
records.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

records.title: Long Overdue
records.description:

For a while, we were supplying them with fuel on credit but when it came time to collect the coward went into hiding. If [TargetName|Last] can’t pay with creds, guess they’re gonna pay with their life.

An associate just clocked [TargetName|Last] at [Location|Address]. I’d love for you to head there now to make the stingy bastard pay.

By the way, it looks like [TargetName|Last] isn’t traveling alone, so I’d make sure you’re fully stocked before going after ‘em. 

- Smokey

records.description:
The folks at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.  

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses. 

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

records.title: Strategic Resource Reserve – Large Resupply
records.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would recruit a full fleet to deliver the supplies to <EM4> Pyro Gateway. </EM4> We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Alliance Aid: Med. Supply of Research Resource
records.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the <EM4>'Forager's Guide'</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Case Summary:

records.title: Finishing The Job
records.description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

records.description:

microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to assist in the search for [TargetName] who was last seen near the Lobby at Lobby but who's current whereabouts are unknown. 

Our preliminary investigation has led us to suspect foul play may be behind their disappearance. As such, heightened caution is advised as there may be hostile actors involved.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

records.title: Orison Relief: Medical Aid Delivery
records.description:
Hello,

Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4> and needs to be dropped at <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. And be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to speed things along.

Thank you, 
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

records.title: Deep space hit
records.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her [Item]. Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to [Location|Address]. 

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to [Destination|Address]. I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, what do you say?
