records.title: F55 Look Better
records.description: Sometimes you shoot people, but if you are last thing they see before dead gun should look amazing, right? Wikelo will make your gun look much better. Bring me items I need and then I give you the gun. Bye.

records.title: Retrieval Op
records.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>
* Deliver to <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

records.description:
We've just received the location of an outlaw outpost where some up-and-coming criminals have been hanging out. Now, our client says there's no reason to engage these folks directly. Instead you will be targeting their supply lines.

Fly on over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and take out their fuel stores while dealing with any minimal resistance they may put up. It will be your call on how much you engage with the hostile forces, just don't forget that your main objective is ensuring those fuel tanks are out of action.

This is a yellow level contract so pay will be proportionate.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.title: Test Armor
records.description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.

records.title: Dangerous Take
records.description:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at [Location|Address] that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines. 

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to [Destination|Address].

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

records.title: Easy Pickings
records.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

records.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply

It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

records.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
records.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy? 

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.   

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,


Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.title: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
records.description:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens. 

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.  

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support. 

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Stows out.

Braden Corchado

Northrock Service Group

records.description:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints. 

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling. 

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one. 

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and you'll need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> without getting security involved. 
 
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line. 

-Twitch

records.title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
records.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at a derelict outpost. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.  

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to [dropoff1] for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to a derelict outpost.
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to [dropoff1|address].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment. 
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Recently a security terminal was illegally accessed using a unique custom cryptokey that had been utilized in a heist last year by one Oslo Arlington, the younger sibling of gang leader Maltrox Arlington. While we we’re unable to positively confirm if the terminal was hacked by Oslo or not, we feel it is worth investigating.

Extremely intelligent, tech savvy and a renowned strategist, Oslo has proven difficult to capture in the past. If this lead does result in finding Oslo, a well coordinated tactical strike team would be advantageous to a successful engagement. 

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch

records.title: The Price of Freedom
records.description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NameSave2], [NameKill1], [NameSave3], and [NameSave1]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

records.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Kass Dent
records.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Two bank guards were reported missing last week. A few hours ago, their bodies turned up in a trash heap in Magnus with their biometrics stolen. Thankfully, a nearby dumpling cart had a security camera that captured the corpses being dropped. Facial recognition was able to ID one Kass Dent, romantic partner to Maltrox Arlington and parent of Les Arlington. Using the vid to construct a timeline, we have provided the coordinates of where Kass is currently believed to be hiding. 

Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.  

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

records.title: Get Supplies from Headhunters Remote Outpost
records.description:
Hi, 

Headhunters must be getting sick of us. I’ve noticed they’ve adjusted their strategy to target more of our supply convoys. Our ability to establish long-lasting security in this system will be based on the strength of supply chains, and the Headhunters know our outposts won’t survive unless they get a constant supply of goods. 

Going to be honest with you. They’re plan is working. They’re knocking out supply convoys faster than we can get new goods into the system. The only way we’ll survive is by finding another supply source. Since they’re already taking so many of ours, I feel justified in taking some of theirs right back. 

There’s one place in particular that I’ve had my eye on. It’s Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] that the Headhunter use to store goods. Need someone to go there, take care of any guards, grab whatever supplies they have, and then take them to [Destination|Address].

Think you could help us with this?

Be safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4>.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>. 

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado

records.title: Tutorial - Your First Steps
records.description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

records.title: Deliver Good Cheer
records.description:
Hey, 

Every once and awhile, Citizens for Prosperity likes to surprise members stationed at our outposts with a little gift to keep morale high. We’ve got the next box ready to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, but need someone to make the delivery for us. Any interest in spreading some good cheer?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: RSI Disc. Month: Orange Lvl. - RSI Ship Under Attack
records.description:
In search of a contractor to help us out of a tight spot.

We were hired by RSI to escort their ship to the Discovery event that's going on, but the moment the group dropped out of quantum, outlaws took out the escort. All we know is that their last known location was <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, but that's about it.

Not for the faint of heart this one, so bring <EM4>back up</EM4> and don't skimp on weapons. You'll need to cover them long enough so they can quantum to safety.

Good luck out there,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.title: Silence Sentries
records.description:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention.  Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at [location|address] and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE. 

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP.  Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.
 
Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly. 

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

records.title: Master Rank - Direct Bulk Cargo Haul
records.description:
Hey there, 

So the People’s Alliance hired us to move a load of cargo from Levski to <EM4>Seraphim Station</EM4>. Honestly, I’m surprised that they export some of this stuff, but I guess they must sell something to be able to afford everything they import. 

For the run itself, you’ll need a ship that can hold <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to handle the containers. That should be it.  

[Contractor|SignOff]
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

records.title: Supplies For Supplies
records.description:
Hey,

Get this. Headhunters raided one of our outposts and ran off with all the supplies. That’s left the folks there in a tough spot because it’s going to take a bit to get new goods to them. But a different plan came to mind that I hope you can help with. 

See, we know the Headhunters have a bunch of their own supplies stashed at [Location|Address]. Feels only fair that we go get them to replace the ones they took from us. I’m looking for someone who not only feels this is fair but is skilled enough to overcome whatever forces are there. When the good are in your hands, they need to go to [Destination|Address], so our folks there can keep that outpost up and running. 

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Missing Volunteers
records.description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of [Location|Address]. It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

We would love to evaluate your hiring potential with this carefully selected itinerary -

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> from the <EM4>[Pickup1|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Package <EM4>#[Item1|SerialNumber]</EM4> to the <EM4>[Dropoff1|Address]</EM4>

If this sounds like something you're interested in, accept this offer right away! Just be sure to bring your own <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> for maximum efficiency. 

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
 -Delivering the Total Package-

records.title: Test Your Mettle
records.description:
Heahunters are on the lookout for motivated and competent contractors who can be trusted to do a wide range of work supporting our operations. If you think you have what it takes, I’ve got a mission here that’ll test your skills in several ways. 

A [Ship] transporting cargo for us is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. Don’t think it’s looking good for our ship, but that cargo is too important to let fall into someone else’s hands. Need you to head to the location and deal with the attackers before they get away, then collect our cargo and take it to [Destination|Address]. 

If you can handle this, then there'll be lots more work I can send your way.  

Stows out.

records.description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TargetName] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at Last Ditch who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TargetName|Last] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TargetName|Last], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

We’ve had our sights set on taking out [TargetName] for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to Lobby and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the Lobby. Kill enough of those losers, and [TargetName|Last] will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

records.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
records.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
Your crew will need to gain access to a <EM4>QV Breaker Station</EM4>, collect the required <EM4>Sadaryx ore</EM4>, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This will require a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4> and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: let's help each other
records.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

records.title: DEAD SAINTS -- Rookie Rank, Small Scale Cargo Run
records.description:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride. 

If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [total] cryopods at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> that need to go to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size <EM4>2 SCU</EM4> containers. If you use a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on. 

HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill. 

If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.

-Twitch

records.description:

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
records.description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

Clashing with some XenoThreat scumbags over at [Location|Address] and learned that [TargetName] is leading them. I ran it by my Judge and she lit up at the chance to take this asshole down, so we want you to head out there and make sure they don't walk away from this attack.

Stows out.

records.title: Clear Outlaw Data Center
records.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation] to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract (Reevaluation)
records.description:
Hey,

I know it's been a little while, but if you are still interested in doing contract work for Northrock, I convinced the management to give you a reevaluation. If you can successfully complete a bounty for us, we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

This pro tem contract is to track down escaped criminal [TargetName]. Try your best to get to them before they can wipe their record at database access point or the job's going to be significantly more difficult.

Hoping we can trust you on this.
 
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

records.title: Built on S71 rifle
records.description: Universe is dangerous in human space. Good to have a good weapon to handle bad situation. Wikelo don't have many weapon, but can make useful ones more useful. If you want, bring stuff and I will do.

records.title: Pyro Region A Lawful Salvage - Medium
Alliance Aid: Medical Cargo Haul - Large Scale
records.description:
Hello,

With the ongoing emergency in Levski, Alliance Aid needs all hands on deck to help transport enough medical supplies to save as many lives as possible. There's a large scale haul over at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> ready to be brought to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This run needs a hauler with a ship that can hold <EM4>8 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. You'll also need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with the crates.    

Please let me know if you can handle this for us.   

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

records.title: Small Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
records.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Pyro System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[Hint_Location] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>Orbituary above Pyro III</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: Junior Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
records.description:
Hello,

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to go to a freight elevator at <EM4>a Salvage Yard on Daymar</EM4> for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than <EM4>8 SCU</EM4>. 

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   
 
[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

records.title: Raid to Recover Supplies
records.description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
records.description:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people. 

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at Shadowfall.

-Stows out

records.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Nicks Cantwell
records.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

We have received word that Nicks Cantwell, long-time acquaintance and confident of Maltrox Arlington, was spotted trying to purchase a high-density mining laser, the kind frequently used in past ship-jacking attempts to strategically breach hulls. We have provided coordinates for Nicks’ last known location.  

Nicks is a highly regarded munitions expert among criminal circles and often leaves a path of destruction in his wake. It is advised to bring an increased level of firepower to this encounter.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target. 

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

records.title: Orison Relief: Strike Nine Tails Squad
records.description:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down. 

We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

records.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
records.description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [Location|Name] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TransitNameShort] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [Location|Name] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

records.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
records.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [Location|Name] and take you to visit Kel-To, a weapons store here in [Location|Name].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

records.title: Out of Detatrine – Large Resupply
records.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

records.title: inventory clear out
records.description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

records.title: Trainee Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
records.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------  

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at <EM4>Canard View</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size. 

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

records.description:

microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary or security professional to report to [Location|Address] and destroy the drugs being stored there. 

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Clear the site of drugs; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• No ongoing addiction issues.

records.title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
records.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we <EM4>update our intel.</EM4>

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old <EM4>QV Logistics station.</EM4>

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the <EM4>encrypted data</EM4> and use the <EM4>decryption key</EM4> to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.


Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

----------------------------

We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

records.title: Simple Hit
records.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [Location|Address] and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around.

records.title: Collect Irradiated Kopion Horns
records.description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver. 

There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect <EM4>irradiated kopion horns</EM4> and deliver them to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee. 

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

records.title: Provide Protection at [Location]
records.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>Fuel Tanks</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

records.title: Scramble Race! ([RaceType|Title])
records.description:
You fast? You deadly? You looking to make some serious creds? Then I got the race for you.

I'm talking a weapons free, old school scramble. Pilot a [RaceType|Short], collect checkpoints, steal points from the leader, and win big. Whoever gets enough points first is declared champion and gets a fat payout. 2nd and 3rd place even get prizes too.  

Let me know if you're interested, and I'll send you the starting coordinates once the race is set up. In the meanwhile, feel free to get your [RaceType] ready to go. [RaceType|ScrambleRaceASOP]

records.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Medium Cargo Haul (Medical)
records.description:
I hope this message finds you well,

Things are a bit crazy than normal around here because of how many of our pilots ended up getting sick while doing runs to Levski. Thankfully, Covalex is contributing to 'Alliance Aid' so hopefully we can put this whole affair behind us soon. 

Currently, I've got a medium scale haul of medical supplies waiting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Really need someone to take it to <EM4>Levski</EM4>, so the team there can operate at full capacity. 

The biggest container on this run will be <EM4>4 SCU</EM4> in size, so have a ship that can handle those. Oh, and don't forget your <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.  

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

records.title: Complete Stranded Ling Shipment
records.description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

records.title: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
records.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist <EM4>Dr. Logan Jorrit</EM4>. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered <EM4>Onyx Facility</EM4> where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and <EM4>access the research lab’s personnel files</EM4> so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

records.title: Orison Platforms Under Attack
records.description:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

records.title: Eradicate Sentries
records.description:

records.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation.

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented security professional who can assist us in securing contraband from an illegal automated production site at [Location|Address]. The packages will then need to be taken to Port Tressler and transferred into our possession for destruction via the administrative commodity terminal.

• Secure contraband and deliver it the commodity terminals at Port Tressler

• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

records.description:

records.description:

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in <EM4>a Salvage Yard on Daymar</EM4> that needs to go to a freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than <EM4>1 SCU</EM4>. 

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.   
 
[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

records.title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
records.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at Canard View. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to Canard View. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.description:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen. 

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.

records.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
records.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract. 

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system. 

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TargetName]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid. 

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon, 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

records.title: Failed Negotiations
records.description:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.
  
Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

records.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around  [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force.

CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

records.title: need an out?
records.description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

records.title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo
records.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Can you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and collect the shipment? You'll need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. records.title: Theft Outpost Pyro Hh Vs Xt Pyro2
let's help each other
records.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

records.title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
records.description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking a derelict outpost. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces. 

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address]. 


** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

records.title: Our Version of The Truth
records.description:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at <EM4>[Destination|Target|Address]</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

records.title: Orison Relief: Small Supply Haul
records.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.

Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to <EM4>August Dunlow Spaceport</EM4>. Pick up’s at <EM4>[Location|Target|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.

Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.

Let’s get it done,

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

records.title: A tricky tricky task
records.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent [TargetName] undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, [TargetName|First] was heading to [Location|Address] to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid [TargetName|Last] might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to [TargetName|Last] and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if [TargetName|Last] is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at [Destination|Address] and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.

Even if the worst has happened, I think they would want us to make sure they data they were charged with protecting isn't used for nefarious gains.

Lima Endicott

records.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
records.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

records.title: Fuel to the Fire
records.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high. 

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

records.title: Breach and Steal
records.description:
Hey there. 

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

Christoph Roester

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

records.title: Personal Effects
records.description:
Hi,

I'll totally understand if you don't want to help with this, but if you can it would be amazing.

See, my boyfriend passed away during the Covalex Gundo tragedy. They said I would get all of Scott's stuff back once the investigation was complete, but as far as I know, it's been done for a while now and they still haven't given any indication of when I can get his property. It's been hard enough dealing with all this, and knowing that a package is going to show up in a month or two and rip open all these wounds, it's just too much. I would prefer to deal with it now and get it over with. If you could find a way to get his personal effects (Employee ID# 104) and drop them off at [Destination], I'd be very grateful.

Thanks for your help,
Anya

microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of [Location|Address].

records.title: Additional Resources For Research
records.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

records.title: Seize the Data
records.description:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

records.title: Running the Gauntlet
records.description:
The CDF has partnered with Anvil Aerospace to find the most capable operatives in the system. 

If you find one of these Platinum certifications, you can redeem the ticket at a ship kiosk at New Deal, Astro Armada or Crusader Showroom for a free F8C. 

The catch is that your identity and location has been shared with participants throughout the system. For everyone else, if you can stop the ticketholder before they get to the kiosk, you can claim the ticket for your own.

Whoever makes it will not only receive this next generation superiority fighter, but also prove that they have what it takes for the toughest CDF assignments.

Good luck.

records.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
records.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>[Item]</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>2 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Wanda Werkheiser

records.title: Orange Level Contract: Handle Security Threat
records.description:
After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.

You will need to find the <EM4>Foxwell Enforcement</EM4> and destroy them before any more data can be gathered. Passive 'Skimmers' like these typically are hard to find so be thorough in your search.

Once attacked, their security protocols will cause them to begin transmitting the contents of their drives, so it’s imperative that you stop the upload before it can complete. There’s also a good chance that whoever’s responsible might be in the area, so be careful.


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Chase Hewitt

records.title: Requesting Help
records.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got an emergency request from Associated Science & Development for any available operators to report to [Location] and deal with some hostiles who have overtaken one of their facilities. 

Once on site, you will need to engage and eliminate any hostile elements. ASD has indicated that this facility provides shuttle services to one of their embedded research centers but were very clear that you are not authorized to travel there. Trespassers will be shot and you will be no exception, so stick to the prescribed AO.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

records.title: Knock Out New Drug Op
records.description:
Some folks will do anything for a few creds. There’s a group of upstart outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have decided to start manufacturing drugs. Turns out they’re not too good at it, or maybe a little too good. The junk they’re pumping out is stronger than the normal stuff and a real danger to anyone who uses it. 

We’ve been hired to knock out their operation and destroy whatever drugs stashes are on site. Armed guards are protecting the place, but they don’t seem too skilled. Our surveillance teams observed one of them almost shoot himself in the foot. Can’t say for certain, but odds are they won’t give a pro like you too many problems.  


Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
